body:
GREG, 2026-11-11 about 07:06Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #921, message c4fba59a), verbatim: „No to nie robmy takich designów. To są cięzkie limity, nie sprawdzaja sie u nas. Limity resetujace operacje powinny byc minuta. A logowac ostrzeżenie po 10 sekunach. Inaczej znowu system przestaje działać!!!”
Context: TermAl's 6000 ms host-adapter deadline killed every `engram work evaluate` submission into TermAl's store (w-ccc13083eaac).
Decision, per Asistant's scope note:
- Any limit that aborts or resets an operation is 60 s.
- At 10 s, log a warning without interrupting.
- First target: TermAl's Engram evaluate adapter. Then review similar hard limits in both projects, and file or fix the fitting places.
- Keep idempotency, and don't duplicate unknown outcomes.
- The write-performance diagnosis continues.
- Ship as fast as possible, confirmed by a test and by an actual same-key resubmit of the retained evaluations, without asking Greg again.
